page.text:
Continuity and the interval domain are both indispensable. A jump
discontinuity can omit all values between its one-sided levels, while a
continuous function on a disconnected domain can take one range of values
on one component and another range on the other. Conceptually, the
theorem says that the continuous image of a connected interval is
connected, hence itself an interval.
